challenge.title: Device verification
challenge.description:
{prompt}.

**Code sent to: {challenge_target}** (this line is authoritative)

Where to look, in order:
1. Huawei Smart Life app on the phone -> Me -> Message centre
2. SMS on the account's bound security phone number
3. Mail on the account's bound security email
4. Huawei ID popup or message on any other device signed in to the same account

Note: this is Huawei's own protection for a **new device sign-in**, triggered server-side, not an extra check added by this integration. Once it passes, the integration reuses the same device identity and will not ask again.
